ShortDescription.Value: Hide notification clutter with a Mini HUD, instant icon controls, road names, road arrows, district names, Money Trends, Population Trends, and Easy City Stats.

Publish.LongDescription:
### City Watchdog
Clean up notification clutter and keep your city easier to read while you build.
#### Features
* **Lower Stress** — reduce information overload. * **Video** of mod use: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IoAuewDJDt4&t=1s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IoAuewDJDt4&t=1s). More features added since this video. * **Mini HUD** — track the notification problems you care about and click an icon to instantly jump to problem locations. * **Show All / Hide All** — instantly show or hide all city notification icons. * **Active Issues** — click the Sort button in the top row until you see Active Issues. * **Road controls** — show/hide road names, district names, and road arrows. * **\[i\] button** — instantly show/hide vanilla mouse-over tooltips. * **Bigger UI** — quick access to the game's interface scaling without launching Developer Mode. * **Extra city info** — shows Money Trends and added population stats.
City Watchdog helps you see and manage city info — it does not fix city problems for you.
#### Good to know
- Open the main panel from the top-left Paw icon. - **Blue Stars** are Mini HUD favorites and are separate from Presets 1 | 2. - Safe to remove any time. No Harmony patches. - **Presets 1 | 2** — save custom notification checkbox layouts. Selecting a preset instead of Hide All will show only the notification icons you want. Blue Stars remain separate Mini HUD favorites. - Milestones and other money-management tools moved to the [Budget + Milestones mod](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/158395/Windows). Install both if you want the previous combined functionality. - Money and Population Trends remain in City Watchdog. - **Hotels:** Vanilla hotels can provide far more rooms than the city has tourists to fill. City Watchdog redistributes available tourists to reduce **Not Enough Customers**, but it cannot create tourists. If warnings remain, remove some hotels or hide the Not Enough Customers icon with City Watchdog.
### Support and feedback
- Enjoy! Support by clicking LIKE 👍 (top right); helps people know about the mod. No donations requested. - Feedback is welcome through the Discord or Github buttons on the right. PRs welcome.
